description: Align items to each other (their combined bounds), to an artboard, or to a key object that stays still (Object > Align, Align panel). center_middle centres both ways in one step

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

keyObjectId.description: With to: key_object, the id of the item the others align to

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

usePreviewBounds.description: Measure including strokes and effects (Use Preview Bounds). Default true

name: align_items
title: Align Items
